title: Spyglass: Officially Launched!
summary: We're thrilled to announce the official launch of Spyglass, a powerful new tool designed to enhance your productivity and insights.

title: Enhanced File Management
summary: Effortlessly manage and customize all your embedded files, from images to documents, with powerful new controls directly within your editor.

title: Discover Our Product Journey: The New Public Roadmap
summary: Explore our exciting product journey with the new public roadmap, clearly showcasing what we've shipped, what's next, and our upcoming innovations.

title: Smarter, More Intuitive Checkboxes
summary: Enjoy a seamlessly updated checkbox experience, now featuring easier dragging, bigger clickable areas, and a modern design that integrates perfectly with your workflow.

title: Improved Real-time Collaboration
summary: We've made real-time collaboration smoother and more intuitive, ensuring everyone stays perfectly in sync while working together.

title: Effortless Shared Content Discovery and Collaboration
summary: Effortlessly find and collaborate on all shared ideas and quests, empowering seamless teamwork and ensuring you never miss important insights.

title: Experience Noeko in Your Preferred Language
summary: Get ready to enjoy Noeko in a wide array of languages, empowering users everywhere to connect and collaborate seamlessly.

title: Noeko Goes Open Source!
summary: We are thrilled to open-source Noeko's codebase, offering unparalleled transparency and empowering our community to directly shape the future of the project.

title: Dynamic Knowledge Map
summary: Explore and manage your knowledge with unprecedented ease as we introduce powerful filtering by tags, time, and shared items directly within your Constellation view.

title: Advanced Search and Collections
summary: This powerful update lets you finely tune your searches with new filtering, sorting, and saving options to create personalized knowledge collections.

title: Enhanced Connected Notes
summary: Explore a more intuitive and interactive way to display and organize your linked notes, designed to perfectly reflect your unique thought process.

title: Noeko: Flexible Deployment & Premium Plans
summary: We are excited to launch Noeko with versatile deployment options, empowering you to host it on your own infrastructure or utilize our convenient cloud service, alongside new premium plans designed for collaborative teams and growing enterprises.

title: Unveiling a World of Stunning New Themes & Refined Classics
summary: We're launching exciting new themes and polishing our current selection to offer you a more beautiful and personalized interface.

title: Smarter Time-Based Greetings
summary: We are enhancing our homepage greetings to always reflect the precise time of day, ensuring a perfectly tailored welcome for every user.

title: Streamlined Tag Organization
summary: Efficiently manage your tagged content by directly unapplying tags or performing other key actions on multiple items, all without leaving the tag view.

title: Expand Your Content Horizons
summary: Soon, you'll be able to seamlessly integrate and work with diverse content sources like YouTube videos, websites, and text files, making all your information accessible in one unified platform.
